newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC, Hewlett-Packard tie up in system integration.
newsitem.headline: NEC, Hewlett-Packard tie up in system integration.

text.p: NEC Corp and Hewlett-Packard Japan Ltd, the Japanese unit of Hewlett-Packard Co, said on Thursday they have agreed to tie up in system-integration projects.
The major computer makers expect the collaboration in setting up computer systems to result in sales totalling 150 billion yen over the next three years, an NEC official told a news conference.
They have already won an order from Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co (KDD) to build its next-generation "mission critical system" based on a large-scale open system.
A "mission critical system" is a computer system used for a specific business operation that requires high reliability, such as billing.
A KDD official said the Japanese international carrier is seeking to upgrade its billing and provisioning systems.
As part of the tie-up, NEC and Hewlett-Packard Japan will set up a technical support centre which is expected to start operating on February 24.
